beats.public_change: The miner threatens to broadcast the algorithm for free.

missions.reason: Needs the pilot to verify the broadcast array is clean before uploading.
missions.private_fact: The algorithm will crash the entire regional economy if released.

beats.public_change: The dust settles after the broadcast decision.

missions.reason: Needs the final decryption keys sent securely to their off-world contact. They specifically need an independent pilot to do this.
missions.private_fact: The keys also contain a backdoor into the algorithm. This is a closely guarded secret they refuse to share.

missions.reason: Needs a specific server rack recovered before the authorities arrive. They specifically need an independent pilot to do this.
missions.private_fact: The rack holds the miner's original identity files. This is a closely guarded secret they refuse to share.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot must choose who gets the algorithm, or if it should be released to everyone.

options.label: Give it to the syndicate
Give it to the corporation
Let the miner broadcast it

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot gives the algorithm to the syndicate.
resolutions.summary: The syndicate corners the black market, growing immensely powerful. The balance of power shifts in a way no one fully anticipated.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot gives the algorithm to the corporation.
resolutions.summary: The corporation buries the algorithm to maintain the status quo. The balance of power shifts in a way no one fully anticipated.
Everyone tries to use it at once. The market collapses completely. The balance of power shifts in a way no one fully anticipated.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails the missions or tampers with the broadcast.
resolutions.summary: The algorithm is lost. The miner goes into hiding. The balance of power shifts in a way no one fully anticipated.

loose_threads.detail: The core logic of the algorithm is written in an ancient, forbidden religious dialect.
The corporate fixer has access to funds that bypass standard banking oversight entirely.

radio_hooks: Rumors of a 'magic formula' for market speculation circulate.
Data brokers report unusual spikes in encrypted traffic.

voice_direction.data_miner: Twitchy, quiet, convinced they are being listened to.
voice_direction.corporate_fixer: Polite, smiling, makes threats sound like friendly advice.

title: The Pension Heist
logline: Desperate veterans hire a pilot to rob the government transport carrying their stolen pension funds.

roles.description: Smug, untouchable, viewing theft as administrative overhead.
An organized group of former soldiers.
A bureaucratic nightmare of a building.

public_situation: A massive bureaucratic 'error' has frozen the pensions of thousands of local veterans.
private_truth: The official is siphoning the funds to pay off a massive gambling debt.

beats.public_change: The official announces a six-month investigation into the missing funds.

missions.reason: Needs a tracking beacon attached to the official's private courier ship while it is docked.
missions.private_fact: The veteran intends to rob the ship to get their money back.

beats.public_change: The official attempts to quietly move the funds off-world.

missions.reason: Needs a pilot to intercept the transport in open space and recover the physical cred-drives.
missions.private_fact: The transport is heavily armed and the veteran cannot provide backup.

beats.public_change: The official issues a massive bounty on the stolen drives.

missions.reason: The official sends a mercenary wing to hunt the pilot and reclaim the drives.
missions.private_fact: The mercenary captain is authorized to offer a split of the funds if the pilot surrenders them.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the mercenaries and keeps the drives for the veterans.
resolutions.summary: The veterans distribute the stolen funds among themselves. The official's corruption is laid bare.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails the heist or takes the split.
resolutions.summary: The funds are lost forever. The official covers their tracks, and the veterans are left destitute.
The official flees the system before the drives are recovered. The funds are stuck in legal limbo.

loose_threads.detail: The official's gambling debts are held by a completely legitimate charity foundation.
The transport ship's transponder was broadcasting clearance codes from a dismantled union shipyard.

radio_hooks: Veterans protest frozen pension accounts.
Auditor claims 'bureaucratic error' to blame for missing funds.

voice_direction.angry_veteran: Furious, sharp, speaks with military precision.
voice_direction.corrupt_official: Oily, dismissive, completely lacking in empathy.

title: The Censored Broadcast
logline: A journalist attempts to broadcast a banned documentary across the region, while the censorship bureau scrambles fleets to silence the relays.

roles.description: Cold, views truth as a threat to public order.
A militant government wing dedicated to information control.
The command vessel of the censorship fleet.

public_situation: A highly anticipated documentary has been officially banned for 'inciting instability'.
private_truth: The documentary proves the government intentionally starved the outer colonies during an economic crisis.

beats.public_change: The censorship bureau begins raiding media outlets.

missions.reason: Needs high-capacity decryption keys delivered to the relay station.
missions.private_fact: The journalist is hiding on the relay and needs the keys to override the local broadcast lock.

missions.reason: Needs the pilot to map the relay's override node structure. They specifically need an independent pilot with a reliable ship.
missions.private_fact: The journalist plans to splice the broadcast directly into government channels. This is a closely guarded secret they refuse to share.

beats.public_change: The first segment of the documentary airs, causing immediate riots.

missions.reason: Needs the pilot to intercept a censorship jammer ship heading for the relay.
missions.private_fact: The journalist's location has been triangulated by the bureau.

beats.public_change: The censor offers amnesty to anyone who turns over the journalist.

missions.reason: The censor contacts the pilot directly, offering a massive payout to destroy the relay's antenna.
missions.private_fact: The censor is acting without official authorization to protect their own career.

beats.public_change: The final, most damning segment of the documentary is preparing to air.

missions.reason: Needs a physical hard drive backup delivered in case the relay is destroyed.
missions.private_fact: The journalist will stay behind to ensure the transmission finishes.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the backup drive.

options.label: Deliver the backup and help the broadcast succeed
Destroy the backup for the censor's reward
Sell the backup to a third-party news network

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot helps the broadcast succeed.
resolutions.summary: The documentary airs system-wide. The government faces a massive uprising, and the censor is ousted.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot betrays the journalist or fails the missions.
resolutions.summary: The broadcast is cut short. The journalist is arrested, and the censor solidifies their power.
The documentary airs, but behind a corporate paywall. The journalist feels betrayed.

loose_threads.detail: The documentary was heavily funded by a rival corporate conglomerate.
The censor's personal files indicate they were planning to defect with the data themselves.

radio_hooks: Controversial documentary banned by regional censorship board.
Unsanctioned broadcasts causing signal interference in outer sectors.

voice_direction.chief_censor: Crisp, authoritative, annoyed by any opposition.
